name: hl
description: Hannah Labs methodology (v3.2) — collaborative development workflow with session lifecycle (start/stop), red-team/blue-team scope refinement, a Kiro-style spec pipeline (spec: grounded requirements → red-teamed lock → designs → red-teamed fold-back → ship-ready tasks), a batch/wave shipping pipeline (ship), an optional autri Dev Memory loop (sessions recall and record their own decisions), and pipeline-shaped progression from drafts through requirements to implementation and deploy. Third iteration after OpenClaw and lean.
